assumptions: warp_init_scaffold is mechanical: pure stdlib file-laying (os, subprocess, sys, pathlib) that reimplements no gate, validator, or index logic - it copies templates and invokes the target repository's own update_index.py and verify.sh - and the produced gate is actually run green in the selftest here. The one transform it applies to the canon is filling the template gate's two intentionally-blank slots (unit and dependency_audit) with na so the empty starter repo gates green; the interactive /warp:init skill remains the front door for real slot configuration.
